title: AMC 8 Practice: Sums of Consecutive Numbers — Which Ones Fail?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on which numbers from 1 to 50 can be written as a sum of consecutive whole numbers, solved with a number board. (Level 5 of 5)
Nine is four plus five, and ten is one plus two plus three plus four. But a few numbers refuse to be built this way! Vantee fills in a 1 to 50 board run by run, then uses blocks to show why only the powers of two fail, and gives you a 1 to 100 version to try yourself.
